newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stocks end with sharp losses, motors weaken.
newsitem.headline: KL stocks end with sharp losses, motors weaken.

text.p: A selldown in motor stocks highlighted a sharply lower finish in Malaysian stocks after another thinly-traded session on Monday, analysts said.
"The market is still not out of the doldrums," said Lai Tak Heong, research director at Socgen-Crosby. "It takes very little to spook the market, and today it's the auto sector."

Motor stocks were hurt by a stronger yen, which would raise the costs of car parts imported from Japan by the companies. The Composite Index of 100 leading stocks slumped 18.85 points or 1.70 percent to 1,088.52.
